description: Dataset for Hydropower Expansion in Eco-Sensitive River Basins under Global Energy-Economic Change is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors AFM Kamal Chowdhury, Thomas Wild (Earth System Science Interdisciplinary Center, University of Maryland, College Park, MD 20740, United States). The data presented in this repository can be fed into the codes provided in this GitHub repository to reproduce the results of the following paper: Chowdhury, A.F.M.K., Wild, T., Zhang, Y. et al. Hydropower expansion in eco-sensitive river basins under global energy-economic change. Nat Sustain 7, 213–222 (2024). Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
